beats: You owe zero tax in Manitoba. The province can still pay you. Three people, one form: MB four seventy-nine.
Case one: Lena cares for her dad at home, unpaid, for more than ninety days. Once she registers, she can claim fourteen hundred dollars a year.
Case two: a couple pays twenty thousand dollars for fertility treatment at a Manitoba clinic. Forty percent comes back. That's eight thousand dollars.
Case three: a homeowner never got the affordability credit on the property tax bill. Claim it on the return: up to sixteen hundred dollars for twenty twenty-six.
The twist: these credits are refundable. Even with no tax to pay, the money still comes to you.
Check form MB four seventy-nine with your return. Most of these credits can be claimed up to three years back.
